name: suwagent
description: Review agent work visually instead of reading walls of text: /visual-spec, /visual-plan and /visual-recap write HTML pages with diagrams, wireframes and an in-page feedback form, plus a session hook that suggests spec → plan → recap for larger changes.

suggest_visual_docs.title: Suggest spec → plan → recap
suggest_visual_docs.description: At session start, tell Claude to offer a visual spec and plan before larger changes and a visual recap after them

publish_mode.title: Where visual documents go
publish_mode.description: artifact: keep the local HTML and also publish it as a claude.ai artifact, with its link in docs/visual/<kind>/claude-artifacts.md. local: keep it on this machine only (for client or confidential repositories)
